t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Be wary of certain colours and ascertain the patterns which are done by the gnomes. If someone gives you 0 mushrooms, avoid picking  that one again.

vb_textbox.text: Often yellow, green, orange and blue will give a good yield at the same time however this will swap over every certain number of goes. If a colour gives you 0, it will continue to do this for the next few rounds. 1.5 seconds goes very quickly so don't let your mind wander at all when you are playing the game. Make use of the breaks otherwise you'll see mushroom trolls until you sleep!
